rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿０１Yo! How's it going?￥Just came by to see you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿０２You've been on a roll lately,￥huh? Your scores are near the￥top, right?＝＠０４８＿０３So what's your secret?￥How're you doing so great?
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿０４Huh.￥So it's not just a hot streak.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿０７I guess I'm pretty inconsistent.＝＠０４８＿０８Even in training, there's a big￥gap between the stuff I'm good￥at and the stuff I'm not...
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿０９When I'm on a roll, though, I￥feel like I could pull off even￥the stuff I'm bad at.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿１２If I trained properly at times￥like that, it'd really stick.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿１３Then again, just feeling like I￥can doesn't mean I actually can.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿１４I'm gonna work hard so I don't￥lose to you.＝＠０４８＿１５So don't you go losing your￥edge so easy!＝＠０４８＿１６See ya.
